Subject: Donation Receipt U/s 80G details


Dear Sir/Madam,


Your support is greatly appreciated by our team as it will help us to implement the goals of the organization. This letter provides documentation for your tax records. We confirm that, as part of this donation you did not receive any goods or services in return. All donations are exempted U/s 80G of the Income Tax Act 1961 for the financial year {{ frappe.db.get_value( "Fiscal Year", {"year_start_date" : ["<=", doc.date_of_donation], "year_end_date": ['>=', doc.date_of_donation]}, "name" ) }}. Registered as a Charitable Trust with Regn No: CIT (E) BLR/12A/T-10/AACCU0660K. Received with thanks from {{ doc.donor_name }} an amount of {{ doc.get_formatted("tranche_amount") }} via Bank Transfer on {{ doc.date_of_donation }} on account of Donation.


We look forward to your continued contributions to Udhyam Learning Foundation's mission.


Thank you once again,

Warmly and with gratitude,

Mekin Maheshwari

Director

Udhyam Learning Foundation
